hotel_name: Lefay Resort & Spa Lago di Garda

claims.text: The resort is in Gargnano, in the heart of the Riviera dei Limoni on Lake Garda.

findings.quote: Lefay Resort & SPA Lago di Garda is located in Gargnano in the heart of the spectacular and renowned

claims.text: The resort sits in 11 hectares of natural park, with woods and olive groves overlooking the lake.

findings.quote: 11 hectares of natural park, surrounded by gentle hills and natural terraces rich in woods and olive groves overlooking a spectacular view of the lake.

claims.text: The resort was founded by Alcide and Liliana Leali, the founders of Air Dolomiti.

findings.quote: Alcide and Liliana Leali, founders of Air Dolomiti, wanted to make a more meaningful contribution to tourism

claims.text: The resort produces more than 75 per cent of its own electricity.

findings.quote: the resort now produces more than 75 per cent of its own electricity

claims.text: The Lefay SPA Method blends Traditional Chinese Medicine and Western techniques under the guidance of a scientific committee.

findings.quote: Lefay SPA Method blends TCM and Western techniques under the guidance of a handpicked scientific committee

claims.text: Arrival consultations are with qualified doctors, usually trained in both Western and complementary medicine.

findings.quote: Arrival consultations are with qualified doctors, usually trained in both Western and complementary medicines

claims.text: The spa has heated indoor and outdoor pools, plus training, ice and thalassotherapy pools and garden whirlpools.

claims.text: The spa has 21 treatment rooms, half of them with lake views.

findings.quote: Apart from 21 treatment rooms, half with lake views
